params.name: limit
params.description: Number of items to return per page (1-1000, default 100).

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of items to skip from the beginning (must be >= 0, default 0).

params.name: id
params.description: The tag identifier to retrieve parameters for.

items.docs: Returns a list of all unique tag parameter combinations for the specified tag.
